caption:
L'Oréal just signed its first ever football sponsorship, and chose PSG to do it.

The French cosmetics giant is now the club's official beauty partner through 2028, landing with one of the most heavily backed clubs in Europe. Beauty brands usually sit in tennis and F1. Picking football says the audience around the men's game has gotten too big to ignore.

Also today: Uber Eats x Real Madrid, LendUX x Adelaide United, Sports Direct Australia x Sydney FC, Bravus x North Queensland Cowboys NRLW, Europcar x New Zealand Breakers.

Expect more unlikely categories to follow L'Oréal into football before this cycle is out.
